C1.worst_defect: The hero is clear, but the home page's 'Before you start' block mixes counter needs with developer-only lines a shop owner cannot act on: 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12' and 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)'. On a phone these push 'At the till' (the page for my staff) down to the last paragraph.
C1.where: home/desktop/02 and home/phone/04-05, 'Before you start' > 'Setting up the store'

C2.worst_defect: The home table answers 'Open and close a register with a Z report' with a plain 'Yes' for your own store. Only Limitations and Troubleshooting say that when the store refuses a till update, 'None of those register records reach your Vendure store from this till, so keep the printed Z reports'.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Live demo or your own store' table vs limitations/desktop/01 last 'At the counter' bullet

C3.worst_defect: A till set up with the documented 'New POS till key' button gets a role without ReadOrder on plugin 0.3.0, so its order history is refused until someone edits the role by hand. This trap shows up only as a mid-paragraph aside in the optional device-key section and in Connect a till step 1. No step in the main sequence checks for it.
C3.where: quick-start text 'Optional: a device key for each till'; connect-a-till/desktop/01 'Give each cashier their own account' step 1

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting is described as covering 'Sync status, selling offline...', so a cashier or owner would open it, but it jumps from header messages into raw GraphQL ('tallyNeedsAdminCommands', 'tallyResolveNeedsAdmin') and 'VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP'. The counter part and the server-admin part are not split into separate pages or clearly marked blocks, apart from one 'This section is for whoever runs your Vendure server' line.
C4.where: troubleshooting/desktop/02-03, 'Resolve a sale the store kept part-way' and 'Fix CORS, 401 or plain-http store problems'

C5.worst_defect: The closure screenshot in 'Count the drawer and close the day' is shown at about 510 px. It is mostly empty card ('Counted €120.09 / Expected €120.09 / Exact' with large gaps above a full-width purple 'Print the Z report' button), so it looks oversized next to the tighter cashier-sheet image above it.

C6.worst_defect: On a phone, the home comparison table becomes seven stacked blocks that each repeat 'Live demo: Yes / Your Vendure store: Yes'. The one row that matters to an owner (refunds: 'No, not on plugin 0.3.0...') is buried two screens down and is hard to scan between customers.

C7.worst_defect: The share card cuts the till screenshot off mid-row at the bottom edge: product cards are sliced through their 'In Stock' badges and the cart's 'Order discount' button is half-cropped.

overall_worst.defect: The home page's owner-facing comparison tells me my till cannot refund and that 'The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup'. That is developer jargon pointing at a developer page. It does not tell a shop owner what actually happens at the counter: hand back cash with Pay out, refund the card on the terminal, ask the person who runs Vendure to settle it. Those practical steps exist only in At the till › Refund a sale.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 and home/phone/04, 'Refund a sale at the till' row
overall_worst.fix: Rewrite that cell in shop terms ('No on plugin 0.3.0: refund in the Vendure Dashboard and record cash with Pay out') and link it to /docs/at-the-till#refund-a-sale instead of Plugin setup.
